[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on organizing their closet and provided tips for categorizing and storing souvenirs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested categorizing souvenirs by trip, using containers and labels, sorting items by type, considering a shadow box or display case, creating a memory book or scrapbook, keeping digital copies, rotating souvenirs, and letting go of duplicates or items that no longer bring joy.
